name: Detect Aberration

targetAreaEffect.value: Quarter circle emanating from the character to the extreme of the range

description: Detects aberrations in the area, revealing more with each round of concentration: round 1, whether any aberrant life is present; round 2, the number of distinct aberrant auras and the strongest one's power (if it's overwhelming and that source's HD/level is at least twice the caster's character level, the caster is stunned for 1 round and the spell ends); round 3, each aura's power and location. Aura power scales with the creature's Hit Dice (Faint at 1-3, Moderate at 4-7, Strong at 8-13, Overwhelming at 14+; a humanoid with the Aberration Blood feat always reads as Faint regardless of HD), and a detected aura lingers for a time that scales with its strength. Each round, the caster can redirect to a new area. Penetrates most barriers except 1 ft. of stone, 1 in. of common metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 ft. of wood or dirt.

otherPrintings.note: Eberron Campaign Setting's version is a distinct Gatekeeper-only variant (cone-shaped emanation) rather than a straight reprint — this Lords of Madness printing is generally available to any druid (as well as clerics and sorcerers/wizards), with a quarter-circle area.

name: Invoke the Cerulean Sign

targetAreaEffect.value: Multiple aberrations whose combined total Hit Dice do not exceed twice caster level in a spread emanating from the character to the extreme of the range

description: An ancient rune-sign anathema to aberrations, traced in the air and released as a pulse of blue light. Every aberration in the area must succeed on a Fortitude save or suffer an effect determined by its Hit Dice relative to the caster's level (closer targets are affected first): HD up to caster level +10, no effect; up to +5, sickened; up to caster level, nauseated; up to -5, dazed; up to -10, stunned. Each effect lasts 1 round, after which the creature steps up one tier toward recovery (stunned to dazed to nauseated to sickened to fully recovered) each subsequent round.

name: Nature's Purity
description: Fires a ray of force dealing 1d6 damage on a hit (2d8 against undead and constructs, or 5d6 with a threat range of 19-20 against aberrations); an aberration slain by the damage is transformed into inert plant matter. Gains one additional ray for every 4 caster levels above 5th (maximum 4 rays at 17th level); multiple rays can target the same or different creatures, but all targets must be within 30 ft. of each other and are fired simultaneously.

name: Pox

targetAreaEffect.value: Up to one living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 10 ft. apart

description: Deals 1d4 Constitution drain to each target, whose skin breaks out in lesions and takes on a pale yellow pallor.
